thread:
Maria S: FYI — Acme SI wants to start integration Monday morning. They hit a blocker on VPC peering + attestation step.
Ajay K: Ugh, what's the exact failure?
Maria S: Customer says the marketplace image fails sig verification; their infra team refuses inbound peering until image attestation is resolved. Error: "signature mismatch" on install.
Priya L: Can we offer a temporary acceptance test? A short-lived public endpoint for their staging subnets? :thinking:
Ken W: Risky but possible. We need a config that limits scope and a short TTL cert. Also need a rollback plan.
deploy-bot: [notice] New task created: SI-1123 - Acme attestation investigation — assigned to Ken W
Ajay K: Ken, can you repro locally using their image and the attestation CLI? If so paste the minimal repro steps.
Ken W: Repro steps I used:
```
# fetch image
curl -o image.tar.gz https://marketplace.example/partner/acme/image:staging
# verify
attest-cli verify --image image.tar.gz --sig ./sig.pem
```
Ken W: Output shows "sig:sha256 mismatch".
Maria S: Acme indicates they signed with an internal CI key and didn't upload public key to the marketplace metadata. Partner PM is on call today to share keys.
Priya L: Action items: 1) Get public key from Acme PM (ETA today EOD). 2) If not available, offer temporary hosted variant for POC. 3) Prepare runbook for VPC peering fallback.
Ajay K: For fallback, propose: a) use hosted endpoint in us-west-2 with rate limit and token isolation, b) short lived credentials, c) disable cross-customer KV caching.
Ken W: I'll draft the runbook snippet and the minimal terraform changes for peering policy. Will drop here in 30m. :memo:
Priya L: Also need sign-off from security on using hosted variant. @mike.security can you weigh in?
Mike S (security): Quick note — hosted POC ok if we put customer in dedicated project, rotate API keys daily, and add egress rules to limit destinations. Need to review VPC peering acceptance criteria before go-live.
Maria S: Great. If keys arrive today we can proceed with standard marketplace flow. If not, we schedule the hosted-POC path and an SI-assisted cutover window Mon 10-12 PST.
Ajay K: I'll be on call Mon morning. Can we set a standby 1hr window for hotfixes after cutover? :thumbsup:
Priya L: Yes — standby window 12-1 PST. I'll send calendar invites once runbook is up.
Ken W: Runbook gist: I'll post in 15.
Maria S: Thanks team. Keeping partner PM looped. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [update] SI-1123 status changed to "in progress" — Ken W
Priya L: Updated timeline in the SI JIRA and slack thread with calendar links.
Maria S: Closing for now — will reopen if anything else pops. Thanks!
